title: Dharma Chakkaram
desc: Chakkaravarthy loses a challenge with Arumugam, which leads to his girlfriend sacrificing her life. Years later, Chakkaravarthy meets another woman who shares her name with his former lover.

title: Marudhani
desc: Manikam, a teacher, comes to work in a village and stays in Marudhani's house. Later, Marudhani falls in love with him after he protects her dignity.

title: Dhavani Kanavugal
desc: An older brother tries to get his five younger sisters married but fails due to their poverty. So, he goes to town for work when an incident completely changes his life.

title: Eeramana Rojave
desc: Shanthi and Siva fall in love in college. However, chaos ensues when a fellow student attempts to break their relationship.

title: Nadodi Pattukkaran
desc: Sundaram, a musician, travels from one place to another along with his troupe. One day, the troupe drives away a group of robbers who terrorise a village and subsequently, they settle there.
